votes.motion: to recommend APPROVAL of PLZ-21-2031 “Crawford short-term rental” located at 4627 West Seminole Circle with the following conditions: 1. The site, structures, and use shall remain in compliance with any and all applicable Riverton City standards and ordinances, specifically the City Home Occupation Ordinance (18.190) and applicable Building and Fire Codes. 2. Short-term renal must be operated within the rule and regulations for Short-Term Rentals as described in Riverton City Code 18.190.051. 3. Applicant must obtain and maintain a Riverton City Business License. Commissioner Breinholt

to amend his motion and recommend APPROVAL of PLZ-21-2028 “Smart Private Lane” located at 1602 West 13595 South with the following conditions: 1. Approval is for a private lane to access one (1) existing lot. 2. Private lane shall follow Riverton City Code for development on private lanes. 3. Private lane shall be a minimum of 20 feet wide paved in either asphalt or concrete according to the standards of the Unified Fire Authority and Riverton City Standards and Specifications. 4.
